string.text: A professor at the Lake Yantar science complex wants two strong gravitational artifacts. He offered to establish a business relationship if I bring them to him.
A request from the leader of Clear Sky

"You ever heard of the Sinners? Bunch of real hardcore bastards. Rumor has it they're holed up somewhere in the Hills near Radar. Their leader... well, people say he's not even human anymore. One of the very first stalkers to ever set foot in the Zone. In short, they're one of the oldest groups around - been here since before everything went to hell. Anyway, at their base up in the Hills there's a building full of old documents. There's one specific folder I need. Think you can get it for me?"
Find documents at the Sin group's base
Bring the documents to the leader of Clear Sky

The scientist at the Yantar science complex is being a real ass. He's refusing to let me into the Professor's bunker over some personal bullshit. Apparently his wife disappeared in a lab under the Dark Valley, and he clearly wants this... silver pendant that he gave her. That's what he's claiming, anyway. Do I go looking for that pendant, or do I send that asshole back there?
Find the silver pendant in the laboratory beneath the Dark Valley
Bring the silver pendant to the scientist
